integrity: An explicit graph-theoretic proof is accompanied by two independent finite breadth-first-search checkers. Priority is assessed against specified consulted publications and indexed sources only.
scientific_limitations: Only fixed-length complete word codes with exactly one deleted word are covered. The formula gives the minimum forbidden-factor length but does not enumerate shortest witnesses; no general-code or multiple-hole optimality is claimed. The original unbordered case is already known. Independent audit has not occurred.
title: Exact period–GCD law for one-hole uniform word codes
